metadata.title: Top 15 Most Dangerous Animals in the World — Ranked by Human Deaths
metadata.description:
You'd guess sharks. You'd guess lions. You'd be wrong.

This is the real ranking of the world's deadliest animals — sorted by how many humans they kill every year. From the apex predators you'd expect to the tiny creatures quietly killing hundreds of thousands, here's the countdown of the 15 most dangerous animals on Earth.

Like and subscribe if #1 surprised you.
